transcript.text: my belling cooker keeps burnin stuff 1 day then next day its undercookd on same temp. been like it a cuple months. thermastat??

First the simple things: check the temperature knob or display matches what you want, the function isn't on grill or a "fast heat / booster" mode, and that recipes for a fan oven are usually 10–20°C lower than conventional. Was a setting or function wrong (and have you changed it), or was it all set normally?
its set normaly, same 180 like always, I havent changed any recipes. just the main oven does it, top oven is fine

Thanks for confirming that. Please take care as the oven and grill get hot quickly, so use oven gloves and don't touch the elements. On the fan setting, look through the door at the fan cover at the back. Can you see or hear the fan turning?

i think so, i can hear it going when i turn it on. cant really see it properly thru the door glass tho, bit greasy lol. last week i did a roast chicken and it was fine then the lasagne after was cold in the middle

[Heading: Thermostat, temperature sensor or control]
Thanks for confirming the fan is running with normal settings. When food burns or cooks unevenly despite these conditions, it usually points to issues with the thermostat, temperature sensor, control unit, an element, or a door seal letting heat escape unevenly. Please do not attempt any tests while the appliance is switched on. An appliance engineer is the necessary next step for this issue, and I am not recommending any specific parts at this stage.
